name: Enhance the River (River Health and Community Fund)
summary: Thames Water grants of up to £150,000 for catchment-scale river habitat restoration, fish passage, floodplain reconnection and invasive species work, part of a fund running to 2030. The second application window is open until 11 January 2027.

eligibility.rule: Partnership project is completed by December 2029
Organisation has a bank account that can receive the grant
Joint project names one lead responsible for funding, communications and delivery

documents: Letter of support from the relevant Catchment Partnership, appended to the form

status.quote: The second application window is now open and will close on 11 January 2027.

deadline.quote: The second application window is now open and will close on 11 January 2027.

applicant_types.quote: Charities, trusts, and charitable incorporated organisations (CIOs) Community and voluntary groups Community Interest Companies (CICs) Faith based organisations as long as the project is inclusive Other public sector organisations, such as councils and local authorities, can apply for our Enhance the River grant.

window.quote: The second application window is now open and will close on 11 January 2027.

amount.quote: Enhance the River offers grants up to £150,000 for a range of catchment-focused projects.

access.quote: This grant is managed internally. We will handle applications and reporting with the recipient organisation.

geography.quote: Please check that your organisation is within our supply area before applying.

co_finance_required.quote: Projects with significant co-funding and a letter of support from their Catchment Partnership will score more favourably.

effort.quote: The second application window is now open and will close on 11 January 2027.
Applications will be reviewed by a panel of local experts, using the assessment criteria outlined on this page.

eligibility.quote: All partnership projects must be completed by December 2029.
Please check to confirm your organisation has a bank account to which a grant can be paid
one organisation must be nominated as the lead and be responsible for funding, communications with us and project delivery.

after_award.quote: Successful applicants will also need to provide regular project updates and complete associated reporting forms.

documents.quote: Please include a letter of support from the relevant Catchment Partnership with your application.
